children.text: 查看你的战役日志。
如果当前是 第一夜 或 第二夜，跳到 开场 8。否则：
如果当前是 第一日，前往 开场 1。
如果当前是 第二日，跳到 开场 4。
如果当前是 第三日，跳到 开场 7。
开场 1：你们从阿克望一路进来的那条路，通往东威克沼时陡然岔出一条支路。景色生机盎然得不可思议，几乎像热带，彩虹纹样的树干如同卫兵一般伫立在黑镜般的池塘边。马奎兹博士和朱迪斯在卡车后车厢里互相打趣，不时拍开蚊蚋。随着话头渐渐变味，你试着请朱迪斯讲个打猎的故事来缓和气氛。
查看你的战役日志。
如果朱迪斯·帕克的关系等级为 1 或更高，前往 开场 2。
否则，跳到 开场 3。

开场 2：朱迪斯毫不犹豫。“看见这道疤了吗？我是在一家地下酒馆里打架弄的。某个富家小子用碎酒瓶划了我。算是友好的推搡，你知道吧。他家里就是这一带的人，而且非常有钱，我再说一遍，他们怕丑闻传出去，就给了我一份差事。倒不是说我会去告发他。”

“我不知道自己指望从保镖嘴里听到什么，但绝不是这个，”马奎兹博士说，语气里可能带着恼意。一阵刺鼻的微风从沼地上吹来，甜腻地散发着死亡的气味，结束了这场对话。卡车停了下来。朱迪斯翻了个白眼，套上一双旧涉水裤，把步枪挎在肩上，走上了沼地。

“信不信随你。我来这儿只是为了钱。”

• 提高朱迪斯·帕克的关系等级。每位调查员获得 1 点奖励经验。

前往 设置。

开场 3：这个年轻女子冷硬的神情缓和下来。“东威克沼里住着个大家伙。一头有虎鲸那么大的顶级掠食者，牙齿锋利如刀，眼睛多得数不清。闻起来像烂掉的海草。”你告诉她，听上去她跟那东西打过交道，她点了点头。“是我欠它的。或者是它欠我的。看见这个没？”她指了指自己脸颊上那道狰狞的疤。“那东西差点弄瞎我的眼。我打算把这笔账算清。”马奎兹博士一脸困惑。“我猜你觉得学者什么故事都会买账，但你要是想让我相信——”一阵刺鼻的微风从沼地上吹来，甜腻地散发着死亡的气味，把朱迪斯的反驳堵了回去。卡车停了下来。朱迪斯把一块方巾拉上遮住口鼻，滑进一双旧涉水裤，把步枪挎在肩上，走上了沼地。

“等你见到它，说不定想法就变了。”

• 在朱迪斯·帕克的笔记中记录 朱迪斯说出了她的积怨。

前往 设置。

开场 4：“我真不明白别人到底喜欢《地心游记》哪一点。空心地球？听着就荒唐，”希奥在雨点砸向卡车驾驶室时絮叨着。景色生机盎然得不可思议，几乎像热带，彩虹纹样的树干如同卫兵一般伫立在黑镜般的池塘边。卡车突然撞上一片深泥，嘎吱一声陷停下来。“我想我需要点帮助，”希奥说。

调查员们必须做出决定（选择一项）：

• “我们可以推！” 前往 开场 5。

• “我们来轰油门。” 跳到 开场 6。
“我们可以推！”
“我们来轰油门。”

开场 5：一番折腾之后，你们把卡车从坑里哄了出来，指引希奥绕过一片坑坑洼洼，开上一处岩石河岸。几个补给袋从后车厢里掉了出来。希奥满不在乎地摆了摆手。“我回来的时候再捡。我在阿克望还有些家里的事要处理。”希奥把你们留在沼地边缘，寒雨中雾气缠绕着他。

• 每位调查员在下一场关卡开始时少 2 点资源。

前往 设置。

开场 6：你们轰着油门，希奥用肩膀顶住卡车车尾。车子向前一冲，却把前轮埋进了另一个坑里。希奥跳上车坐到你旁边，恼火地叹了口气。“我看你们得从这儿步行过去了。路不算远。”

• 每位调查员在下一场关卡开始时少 1 个行动。

前往 设置。

开场 7：通往东威克沼的路上布满粗粝的坑洞，映出天空中绚烂的棱彩色泽。路况越来越险，希奥把卡车停了下来。“很抱歉只能这样，但这老姑娘可过不了那片烂泥，”希奥说。你们从后车厢下来，与希奥道别，沿着泥泞的道路走下去，穿过一片密实的树丛，那些艳丽花哨的彩树被一道道光的裂隙劈开。

前往 设置。

开场 8：月光亮得如同白昼，把卡车四周荒凉的景色照得像格林童话里的场景。你们在岸边停下车，抬头望向被渐聚的云层遮掩的月亮，一阵刺鼻的微风从沼地上吹来，甜腻地散发着死亡的气味。一棵细瘦的树在月光下显出剪影，像一只攫抓的手向上伸去。你们把补给从卡车里搬出来，回头望去。那棵细树已经消失了，身后只留下一道黑色的涟漪。

前往 设置。

children.text:
下沉地点

在本关卡中，伤害标记会以渗坑的形式被放置在地点上，以表示沼地的下沉。当地点上带有三个或更多渗坑时，它会因议程的强制效果而翻面。

• 接到翻转某个地点的指示时，弃掉该地点上的所有伤害标记（不是调查员或敌人身上的）。然后将其翻面，保留该地点上的所有调查员、敌人、附属的诡计与线索。弃掉该地点上所有玩家卡附属。

• 接到翻转某个地点的指示时，弃掉该地点上的所有伤害标记（不是调查员或敌人身上的）。然后将其翻面，保留该地点上的所有调查员、敌人、附属的诡计与线索。弃掉该地点上所有玩家卡附属。

如果你不控制瑞玟·霍桑：

“我讨厌这片沼地。我猜所有从山谷失踪的人都被送到这儿来了，这儿太危险了。可蕾切尔嬷嬷还是叫我来这儿。我真希望自己还在纽约，”瑞玟说，他们穿着过于宽大的涉水裤，显得格格不入。他们把一只篮子塞进你怀里。“带我去找些蔓越莓，快点。”

记住“瑞玟‘请求’了帮助”。接管瑞玟·霍桑。你可以在蔓越莓沼地点再次触发本法典（见第28页的地点摆放示意图）。

如果你控制瑞玟·霍桑，且位于蔓越莓沼地点（见第28页的地点摆放示意图）：

“谢谢。这事我大概自己也能办成，不过还是谢谢你的好意，”瑞玟说着，采下一束蔓越莓花。“谁会要蔓越莓花？蕾切尔嬷嬷。我猜她把不喜欢的人都派到这儿来，指望他们‘消失’。我费了那么大劲去讨好那头老獾。等我从阿特伍德一家手里夺回这座岛，第一个就收拾她。”

提高瑞玟·霍桑的关系等级。每位调查员获得 1 点奖励经验。将瑞玟·霍桑移出游戏。

如果朱迪斯说出了她的积怨：

“趴下！”朱迪斯喊道。你俯身低头，这个娇小结实的女人端起猎枪，瞄准，朝你脑袋刚刚所在的位置开了一枪。一声尖叫随之响起，接着是响亮的落水声。朱迪斯坏笑着把你拉起来。“你最好帮我杀了深处那东西。就今天。”

选择场上的一个非精英敌人。击败该敌人。接管朱迪斯·帕克。

否则：

朱迪斯抓住一根树枝稳住身体。“这整片沼地都在下沉。以前可没这么糟。感觉像是深处有什么东西挪动了。很大的东西。我看我们该待在一起。你知道的。这样我才能保护你，”她露出一个笑容。

接管朱迪斯·帕克。

story.title: [codex] 法典 Θ：罗莎·马奎兹博士

children.text:
“来看看这个，”马奎兹博士招手让你走向一株带条纹的树干。“这不可能。五种不同的物种长在了一起。我想不出哪种嫁接方法能造出这样的东西。”她用手杖敲了敲树干，俯身探手，拽出一大束色彩斑斓的粗根，看上去像天使的头发。“不过它们很结实。它们的根类似蘑菇群落的菌丝网络，但要粗得多。贴着树走，你就不会陷下去。”

选择场上的任意地点。如果它是 沼地 地点，移除其上的全部渗坑。如果它是 沉没 地点，将其翻面，保留其上所有标记与附属。

如果未达成结局（每位调查员都被击败）：你在沼地岸边的一处林间空地上醒来，希奥就坐在旁边。你还没开口，这个年轻人便嘘了一声，指向树丛中的一处缺口。一段光缝前，一头雄伟的雄鹿显出剪影。它长而盘绕的鹿角上覆满苔藓与真菌，通体散发着苍白的微光。希奥咧嘴一笑。“很美吧？我是说，它要是看见我们，肯定会杀了我们。不过，嗯，”他摆了摆手。“我很高兴找到你了。岸边有什么东西在动，不过我没费心去看。你没事就好。”

• 每位调查员获得 1 点奖励经验，因为他们对铁杉岛独特的生态系统有了洞见。

• 跳到 结局 5。

结局 1：从修枝剪剪断茎秆的那一刻起，你就知道出事了。当你把那朵发着微光的灰色花朵从它背上摘下来时，那头爬行类生物发出哀鸣，随即张开嘴，露出成排的锯齿状牙齿，朝你咬来。白色如砒霜的液体从中空的茎里喷出，把你裹在一层灼烧皮肤的恶臭分泌物里。你踉跄后退，几乎把花掉在地上，这才意识到自己犯了错。液体散发的雾气让你头晕目眩，也让森林显出夸张的荧光。那头可怜的爬行类生物在痛苦中挣扎，沉了下去，水面上留下缕缕乳白色的血。一阵剧痛逼你把那朵含生物碱的花丢下，你查看自己的手，发现掌心有一道锐利的割伤。伤口的形状表明，那根茎已经开始刺入皮肉。你把样本装进标本罐，朝南岸走去。

• 在战役日志中记录 鳄龟混种死亡。

• 每位调查员获得 1 点奖励经验，因为他们研究了东威克沼独特动植物的一部分。

• 跳到 结局 5。

结局 2：你身后响起一声扳动枪机的咔哒声。“退后，”朱迪斯说着从矮树丛里钻出来。她瞄准那头爬行类混种。“离那东西远点。”

马奎兹博士走到朱迪斯与那头生物之间。“恕我直言，那‘东西’完全无害。”仿佛为了强调她的观点，那头生物嚼起一根开花的树枝。

“这座岛上没有什么东西是无害的，”朱迪斯反驳道。“所有东西，就连那些温顺的龟、可爱的小鹿，还有那些该死的兔子，都能要人命。我不明白村民们怎么就不更害怕些。我跟你保证，这只龟……玩意儿可不只是嚼嚼花。”

“你要是开枪打了我来这里勘察的东西，就别想拿到钱，”马奎兹博士冷冷地说。教授掏出笔记本，开始给那头生物画速写。一对青蛙从生物前方的池塘游过，众人顿时安静下来。转眼间，鳄龟混种张开嘴，露出喉咙深处四排彼此分开的牙齿，随即把两只青蛙一口咬住。

马奎兹博士放下速写本。“这到底是什么鬼——”

• 在战役日志中记录 鳄龟混种存活。

• 每位调查员获得 3 点奖励经验，因为他们目睹了东威克沼独特动植物的一部分。

• 跳到 结局 5。

结局 3：你在一个黑镜般的池塘里找到了那株正在开花的爬行类生物。你还没来得及动，一条带刺的触手就把混种举到半空，悬在一张尸骨堆积的血盆大口之上。那头生物发出最后一声可怜的呻吟，被丢进了满是尖牙的嘴里。听到它的壳在那怪物强有力的颚间碎裂，你的胃一阵翻搅。随着深沼之物沉入沼地之下，一声低沉而满足的轰响随之而来。

• 在战役日志中记录 鳄龟混种被吞噬。

• 每位调查员承受 1 点精神创伤。

• 每位调查员获得 1 点奖励经验，因为他们对铁杉岛独特的生态系统有了洞见。

• 跳到 结局 5。

结局 4：深沼之物痛苦地咆哮着，挥舞着它众多的肢体。冲击波在柔软潮湿的地面上荡开，把一片片树林化为引火物。两声清脆的爆响划破空气，你手脚并用地想抓住立足之处。那头庞然巨物咕噜作响，它瘪下去的气囊勉力想把它托起来。最后一声咆哮戛然而止，深沼之物沉入了腐臭的沼泽之下。

• 在战役日志中记录 深沼之物已被击败。

• 前往 结局 5。

结局 5：“密斯卡托尼克勘察队，1926年6月。成员：马奎兹、马斯格雷夫等。勘察区域：东威克沼。大量异常体型的植物，以及能够控制宿主的寄生种类。生态系统繁盛得令人压抑。具攻击性的水生生物。比起森林更像丛林。不是寻常的沼地。需要带着更多经费再来一趟。”

• 每位调查员获得等同于胜利区中每张卡牌胜利 X 数值的经验（（按上述说明计算））。每位调查员现在可以花费战役日志中“未花费经验”下记录的经验。

• 在战役日志的“已勘察区域”部分勾选 东威克沼。

intro.title: Scenario: The Thing in the Depths

children.text: Check your Campaign Log.
If it is Night 1 or Night 2, skip to Intro 8. Otherwise:
If it is Day 1, proceed to Intro 1.
If it is Day 2, skip to Intro 4.
If it is Day 3, skip to Intro 7.

Intro 1: The road to Eastwick Bog branches sharply off from the same road you took in from Akwan. The landscape is incredibly vibrant, almost tropical, with rainbow-patterned tree trunks standing guard at the edge of black mirrored ponds. Dr. Marquez and Judith trade friendly barbs in the truckbed, occasionally swatting away gnats. As the conversation turns sour, you attempt to break the tension by asking Judith for a hunting story.
Check your Campaign Log.
If Judith Park's Relationship Level is 1 or higher, proceed to Intro 2.
Otherwise, skip to Intro 3.

Intro 2: Judith doesn't miss a beat. "See this scar? I got it in a fight at a speakeasy. Some rich kid cut me with a broken bottle. A friendly scuffle, y'know. His family was from this area, and very rich, I'll add again, and they were so afraid a scandal'd break out that they offered me a job. Not that I woulda ratted on him."

"I don't know what I expected to hear from a bodyguard, but it wasn't that," says Dr. Marquez, possibly annoyed. An acrid breeze, smelling sweetly of death, blows off the bog and ends the conversation. The truck comes to a stop. Judith rolls her eyes, pulls on a pair of old waders, and walks out onto the bog, rifle slung over her shoulder.

"Believe me or don't. I'm just here for the money."

• Increase Judith Park's Relationship Level. Each investigator earns 1 bonus experience.

Proceed to Setup.

Intro 3: The young woman's steely demeanor relaxes. "Something big lives in Eastwick Bog. An apex predator the size of a killer whale, with razor sharp teeth and too many eyes. Smells like rotten seaweed." You tell her it sounds like she has personal experience with the creature, and she nods. "I owe it. Or it owes me. See this?" She points to the wicked scar on her cheek. "That thing almost took my eye. I plan to settle the score." Dr. Marquez is nonplussed. "I guess you think an academic will buy up any story, but if you expect me to believe—" An acrid breeze, smelling sweetly of death, blows off the bog and stops Judith mid-retort. The truck comes to a stop. Judith pulls a bandana over her nose and mouth, slides into a pair of old waders and walks out onto the bog, rifle slung over her shoulder.

"Maybe if you meet it, you'll think differently."

• In Judith Park's Notes, record Judith shared a grudge.

Proceed to Setup.

Intro 4: "I really didn't get what everyone else liked about Journey to the Center of the Earth. A hollow earth? It sounds insane," Theo chatters as rain hammers down on the truck cabin. The landscape is incredibly vibrant, almost tropical, with rainbow-patterned tree trunks standing guard at the edge of black mirrored ponds. The truck suddenly hits a patch of deep mud and squelches to a halt. "I think I need some help," Theo says.

The investigators must decide (choose one):

• "We can push!" Proceed to Intro 5.

• "We'll rev the engine." Skip to Intro 6.
"We can push!"
"We'll rev the engine."

Intro 5: After some struggle, you coax the truck out of the pothole and point Theo through a mess of other potholes onto a rocky bank. Several bags of supplies fall out of the truckbed. Theo waves dismissively. "I can get those on the way back. I've got some family stuff back in Akwan to take care of." Theo leaves you at the edge of the bog, wreathed in mist in the chill rain.

• Each investigator begins the next scenario with 2 fewer resources.

Proceed to Setup.

Intro 6: Theo presses his shoulder to the rear of the truck as you rev the gas. The vehicle lurches forward only to bury the front tire in another pothole. Theo jumps into the truck next to you and lets out an exasperated sigh. "I think you'll have to continue on foot from here. It's not that far."

• Each investigator begins the next scenario with 1 fewer action.

Proceed to Setup.

Intro 7: The road to Eastwick Bog is covered in rough potholes that reflect a brilliant, prismatic sheen in the sky above. Theo stops the truck as the road grows treacherous. "I'm sorry to do this, but this old girl can't make the trip through all that mud," Theo says. You step off the truckbed, say goodbye to Theo, and walk down the muddy road past a close thicket of gaudy, colored trees riven with cracks of light.

Proceed to Setup.

Intro 8: The moonlight is as bright as day, illuminating the desolate landscape around the truck like something in a Grimm fairy tale. An acrid breeze blows off the bog, smelling sweetly of death, as you pull to a stop on the shoreline and look up at the moon, veiled in gathering clouds. A single thin tree stands silhouetted against the moon, reaching up like a grasping hand. You hoist your supplies out of the truck and look back. The thin tree has disappeared, leaving a dark ripple in its wake.

Proceed to Setup.
Bonus experience

setup.text: Gather all cards from the following encounter sets: The Thing in the Depths, Blight, The Forest, and Mutations.
In addition, check the Campaign Log for the current day and gather its corresponding encounter set for The First Day, The Second Day, or The Final Day.
Check your Campaign Log for the current day and time. Put the Time Marker card into play on its corresponding (Day [day]) or (Night [night]) side.
If it is Day 2 or Night 2, place 1 doom on the agenda.
If it is Day 3, place 2 doom on the agenda.
Gather the 10 double-sided locations and shuffle them. Remove one of these locations from the game at random. Put the remaining 9 locations into play in a 3×3 grid with their Bog side facing up.
See Location Adjacency below.
Each investigator begins play at the "Starting Location."
If it is (Day [day]), gather each story asset from the Residents encounter set. This set is indicated by the following icon:
If it is Day 1, place Judith Park at the North Shore location. Put Dr. Rosa Marquez into play under the control of an investigator. She does not take up an ally slot during this scenario.
If it is Day 2 or Day 3, place River Hawthorne at the North Shore location.
Remove each other card in the Residents encounter set from the game.
Set the following cards aside, out of play: the Thing in the Depths enemy, the Chelydran Hybrid enemy, and all five copies of the Grasping Tendril enemy.

children.text:
Sinking Locations

During this scenario, damage tokens are placed on locations, as sinkholes, to represent the sinking of the bog. When a location has three or more sinkholes on it, it will flip via the agenda's forced effect.

• When instructed to flip a location, discard all damage tokens on that location (not on investigators or enemies). Then, flip it, keeping all investigators, enemies, attached treacheries, and clues on that location. Discard all player card attachments from that location.

• When instructed to flip a location, discard all damage tokens on that location (not on investigators or enemies). Then, flip it, keeping all investigators, enemies, attached treacheries, and clues on that location. Discard all player card attachments from that location.

If you do not control River Hawthorne:

"I hate this bog. I assume that everyone who's gone missing from the Vale was sent here, it's so dangerous. Yet still, Mother Rachel told me to come here. I wish I were back in New York," River says, looking out of place in their oversized waders. They press a basket into your arms. "Get me to some cranberries and be quick about it."

Remember that "River 'asked' for help." Take control of River Hawthorne. You may trigger this codex again at the Cranberry Bog location (see the Location Placement diagram on page 28).

If you control River Hawthorne and are at the Cranberry Bog location (see the Location Placement diagram on page 28):

"Thank you. I probably could have done this on my own, but I appreciate the gesture," River says, gathering a bundle of cranberry flowers. "Who wants cranberry flowers? Mother Rachel. I assume she sends people she doesn't like out here in hopes they'll 'disappear.' I've tried so hard to curry favor with that old badger. Once I've taken this island back from the Atwoods, she'll be first to go."

Increase River Hawthorne's Relationship Level. Each investigator earns 1 bonus experience. Remove River Hawthorne from the game.

If Judith shared a grudge:

"Get down!" Judith shouts. You duck as the compact woman hoists her rifle, takes aim, and fires where your head just was. A shriek follows, then a loud splash. Judith helps you to your feet with a smirk. "You'd better help me kill that thing in the depths. Today."

Choose a non-Elite enemy in play. Defeat that enemy. Take control of Judith Park.

Otherwise:

Judith grabs on to a tree branch to steady herself. "This whole bog is sinking. It wasn't always be this bad. Feels like something shifted down in the deep. Something big. I guess we should stick together. Y'know. So I can protect you," she flashes a smile.

Take control of Judith Park.

"Take a look at this," Dr. Marquez beckons you to a striped trunk. "It's impossible. Five different species in one. I can't think of a grafting method that could produce something like this." She taps the trunk with her cane, reaches down, and pulls up a thick many-colored bundle of roots that look like angel's hair. "They're sturdy, though. Their roots resemble the mycelia network of a mushroom colony, but are much thicker. Stick to the trees, and you won't sink."

Choose any location in play. If it is a Bog location, remove all sinkholes from it. If it is a Sunken location, flip it, keeping all tokens and attachments.

If no resolution was reached (each investigator was defeated): You awaken in a glade near the bog shore with Theo sitting nearby. Before you can say anything, the young man shushes you and points to a break in the trees. Silhouetted against a sliver of light is a magnificent stag. Its long, looping antlers are covered in moss and fungal growths and it glows with a pale incandescence. Theo grins. "Isn't it beautiful? I mean, I'm sure it'd kill us if it saw us. But, well," he waves his hand. "I'm glad I found you. There was something moving down on the shore, but I didn't bother checking. I'm just glad you're okay."

• Each investigator earns 1 bonus experience as they gain insight into the unique ecosystem of Hemlock Isle.

• Skip to Resolution 5.

Resolution 1: You can tell from the moment your clippers cut the stem that something is wrong. The reptile moans as you lift the glowing gray blossom from its back, then opens its mouth to expose rows of serrated teeth as it snaps at you. Arsenic white fluid spurts from the hollow stem, coating you with a stinking secretion that burns your skin. You nearly drop the blossom as you stumble back, realizing your mistake. The vapors from the fluid make you dizzy and lend the forest an exaggerated fluorescence. The poor reptilian creature flails in pain and sinks, leaving swirls of milky blood on the surface. A sharp pain forces you to drop the alkaloid blossom, and you examine your hand to find a sharp cut on your palm. The shape of the wound suggests the stem had begun to penetrate the flesh. You put the sample in a specimen jar and head for the southern shore.

• In your Campaign Log, record the Chelydran Hybrid perished.

• Each investigator earns 1 bonus experience as they study a part of Eastwick Bog's unique flora and fauna.

• Skip to Resolution 5.

Resolution 2: A gun clicks behind you. "Hold back," Judith says emerging from the undergrowth. She takes aim at the reptilian hybrid. "Keep clear of that thing."

Dr. Marquez steps between Judith and the creature. "With all due respect, that 'thing' is completely harmless." As if to underscore her point, the creature chews a flowering branch.

"Nothing on this island is harmless," Judith retorts. "Everything, even the sweet turtles and the cute deer and the damn rabbits are deadly. I don't know why the villagers aren't more afraid. I can guarantee you this turtle…thing doesn't just munch flowers."

"If you shoot the thing I came here to survey, you will not be paid," Dr. Marquez says coldly. The professor pulls out a notebook and begins sketching the creature. A hush falls over the group as a pair of frogs swim across the pond in front of the creature. In an instant, the chelydran hybrid opens its mouth to expose 4 separate rows of teeth lining the back of its throat, then snaps up both frogs.

Dr. Marquez puts down her sketchbook. "What in the hell—"

• In your Campaign Log, record the Chelydran Hybrid lived.

• Each investigator earns 3 bonus experience, as they witness a part of Eastwick Bog's unique flora and fauna.

• Skip to Resolution 5.

Resolution 3: You find the blossoming reptile in a black mirrored pond. Before you can so much as move, a spined tentacle raises the hybrid into the air over a charnel maw. The creature lets out one last pitiful groan as it is dropped into the fanged mouth. Your stomach turns when you hear its shell crack between the abomination's powerful jaws. A low, satisfied rumble follows as the Thing sinks beneath the bog.

• In your Campaign Log, record the Chelydran Hybrid was devoured.

• Each investigator suffers 1 mental trauma.

• Each investigator earns 1 bonus experience, as they gain insight into the unique ecosystem of Hemlock Isle.

• Skip to Resolution 5.

Resolution 4: The Thing roars in pain as it flails its many limbs. Shockwaves ripple through the soft, wet ground, reducing groves of trees to tinder. You scramble for purchase as two sharp pops punctuate the air. The monstrous creature gurgles as its deflating air bladders struggle to buoy it up. Its last roar is cut short as the Thing sinks below the fetid marsh.

• In your Campaign Log, record The Thing in the Depths was defeated.

• Proceed to Resolution 5.

Resolution 5: "Miskatonic Survey, June 1926. Members Marquez, Musgrave, et alii. Area surveyed: Eastwick Bog. Numerous abnormally sized flora, parasitic variety capable of controlling its host. Oppressively abundant ecosystem. Aggressive water life. More jungle than forest. Not your average bog. Will need to return with more funding."

• Each investigator earns experience equal to the Victory X value of each card in the victory display ((calculate as instructed above)). Each investigator may now spend the experience recorded under "Unspent Experience" in your Campaign Log.

• In the "Areas Surveyed" section of your Campaign Log, check off Eastwick Bog.
